title: Excalibur Pittsburgh Tournament cEDH: Yisan v Sisay v Kinnan v MalcolmVial
event: Excalibur Pittsburgh 2026 top 16 (stream overlay); casters call it 'Steel City Spectacular 2026' at [48:58]. Casters: Ty Ohio, Eric Beagle.

players.note: confirmed from on-screen seat overlays via video frame sampling 2026-08-24 (overlay spellings kept; auto-captions render Swaney as 'Sweeney'/'Swainy')

extraction.method: manual LLM read of timestamped auto-captions (data/transcripts/B421mac67IE.txt) plus targeted video frame sampling (yt-dlp --download-sections + ffmpeg stills at ~13:00, 30:00, 51:00, 52:40, 57:30, 66:00, 78:00) for seat overlays, life totals, card popups, and the win moment
caveats: One 87-minute game with heavy table talk, deal-making, and commentary cutaways; auto-captions garble card names, repaired against the published decklists with each repair flagged.
Mid-game commander-control bookkeeping (Volatile Stormdrake exchanges, clones, Sudden Substitution) is the least reliable stretch; entries there carry explicit confidence labels.
Turn boundaries are frequently inaudible; the round count is an estimate built from 'untap/upkeep/draw' markers and is labeled as such.
Life totals come from sampled frames only (six snapshots), not a continuous read.

games.seat_order_confidence: high; read directly from the stream's numbered seat overlays in sampled frames
games.win_turn_note: table rounds = the winner's own turns elapsed. Matt turn markers identified at ~11:31, 12:37, 14:21, 22:15, 47:41, 50:33 and the winning turn at 71:37; roughly 3 mid-game Matt turns (~24-47 min) left no clear caption marker. Estimate 10, plausible range 9-12.
games.win_method: Engine win out of the Sisay 99 after Sisay itself was stolen: Smothering Tithe treasure hoard (17 treasures at one point) plus Matt's own Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy doubling them; repeated 7-mana Kinnan activations ('spins') deploy Enduring Vitality (every creature becomes a mana dork), Derevi, Empyrial Tactician, Ignoble Hierarch and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer; Emiel the Blessed blinks Derevi for unbounded untaps = infinite mana; then the stated deterministic line: spin until Deadpool, Trading Card, text-box swap Deadpool with the stolen Sisay, activate the reclaimed Sisay ability to fetch Mount Doom, and use Mount Doom's board-wipe ultimate to kill the table. Opponents concede ('GG's', 78:05-78:17). Crucially the whole line is activated abilities, dodging Isaac's Damping Sphere spell tax.

games.creator_self_review: Post-game interview [81:20-86:38]: Matt credits the win to a year of Kinnan experience ('I'll do a Kinnan game plan. I'll spin.') and names his three live outs as Deadpool or Emiel+Derevi for infinite mana; confirms 'if Dexter doesn't fierce my crop rot, they're dead three turns earlier'; casters judge Dexter's deal-keeping as the losing choice ('the deal handicapped him too bad'). Matt also reveals Mount Doom was scouted on an early Kinnan flip.

study_relevant: Commander theft (Volatile Stormdrake, Imposter Mech, Sudden Substitution) drove the whole midgame: the winner won out of his 99 after losing his commander, a line no goldfish metric captures
Explicit multi-turn deal-making decided the outcome: Dexter honored a no-shenanigans deal instead of contesting the win, and casters call that the losing decision
The winning line is all activated abilities specifically because Damping Sphere taxed spells: human piloting routed around a stax piece by changing resource type
Pace: one game, ~67 minutes of play, ~10 winner turns, held in stasis ~45 minutes by a single 2-drop (Collector Ouphe)
Smothering Tithe accumulated ~17 treasures across the stall and converted the whole hoard the turn the lock broke
